protocol.role: outcome-neutral local catalogue prevalence development screen
protocol.catalogue_topology_equivalence: exact equality of node, scenario_id, lanes, ordered workloads, and ordered (action_id, requirements); duration and model_scope are excluded
protocol.duration_variant_equivalence: exact equality of topology fields plus ordered (action_id, requirements, duration)
protocol.dominance_rule: same exact requirement vector and strictly smaller max(1, duration)
protocol.advance_gate: at least two distinct ordered action catalogue topologies each have a nonempty quotient with a valid full-catalogue canonical lift

decision_rule.INVALID_EXECUTION: one or more read-only inventory checks fail
decision_rule.MULTI_CATALOGUE_SCALING_ADVANCE: at least two distinct ordered action catalogue topologies each have a nonempty quotient with a valid full-catalogue canonical lift
decision_rule.SINGLE_CATALOGUE_TOPOLOGY_STOP: the frozen roster contains fewer than two distinct ordered action catalogue topologies
decision_rule.CROSS_CATALOGUE_DOMINANCE_NOT_OBSERVED_S: multiple catalogue topologies exist but fewer than two have a nonempty canonically liftable quotient

protocol.claim_boundary: A deterministic development inventory of local complete-frame catalogue snapshots. Equality of ordered action_id and requirement vectors defines one catalogue topology; exact duration equality defines variants within that topology. Repeated lineage snapshots do not count as independent catalogues. The screen does not establish selector scaling, wall time, trajectory performance, external-system prevalence, or a paper claim.
protocol.prohibited: server pulls, RNG, arrivals, trajectories, selector calls, wall-time claims, paper edits, and dropping roster members after observing their quotient

next_step: Do not launch cross-catalogue scaling from repeated versions of this roster; retain the quotient as a single-action-catalogue optimization until a genuinely different supported physical catalogue is available.
